title: Is Hunyuan3D the current best low poly model creation software, or may there be better ones for specifically low poly?
author: Fluid-Tap5115
selftext:
Really wanna make some test assets, about 1000 poly count wise for my first game

But I am still learning as I go, but is Hunyuan3D the best low poly results giving ai available rn?

replies.author: FutureLynx_
replies.body: is that free? didnt allow me to do even one..

comments.author: buu_ai
comments.body: You can check out Buu AI too and compare

replies.author: samanthablacktattoo
replies.body:
I could not retrieve the centaur but this is an example of how bad the example was, check those hands.

https://preview.redd.it/8yfwy9s7ywjg1.png?width=736&format=png&auto=webp&s=fa70ec68546fc46a1aa6ed7a64418e12f0ca5b88

comments.author: CanadaSoonFree
comments.body: I’ve yet to get it to create a good model at 1000 poly count but it’s definitely doable with blender touches.

comments.author: Apoptosis-Games
comments.body:
Not sure if anyone's mentioned this previously, but I've been using Meshy's beta low-poly mode and it's actually not terrible.

Depending on your generation, it'll make something between 1500-8k polys.

Just last night, I had it use an image reference of a body covered in a sheet on a gurney, and it made one using about 6k polys.

comments.author: One-Hearing2926
comments.body: I tried all of them and seems it's currently the best, both at low poly and high poly, plus it can also rig.

comments.author: RussellMayfield1
comments.body: Hunyuan3D is solid, but not really the best just for low-poly. Most people still generate and then optimize in tools like Blender Foundation, or use faster pipelines like Tripo AI. It’s good, just not low poly focused by design from Tencent.

comments.author: spacespacespapce
comments.body:
[nativeblend.app](http://nativeblend.app)

it builds the model with Blender, part by part that you can edit instead of spitting out a messy mesh to clean up
